typeContract: Ordinary annotations are compile-time information. Explicit source type tests/conversions retain their observable runtime semantics. JS.assume assertions erase. Existing int arithmetic semantics are unchanged.
compilerFixes: Native public classes retain helpers required by their prototype methods.
Initializer calls named of do not terminate declaration parsing.
Pure export annotations preserve binding identity and argument effects.
Opaque template uses keep their callback and captured bindings live in token and tree optimizers.
portFixes: One shared ESM graph preserves constructors, frame queues and caches across entry points.
Native controls use shared prototype methods and original stop binding behavior.
Typed options, numeric state and callbacks remove redundant source guards and adapters.
Completion promises, keyframe array identity, undefined/null handling and option getter semantics follow Motion.
Pure factory metadata supports removal of unused initialization.
coverage: Selected animation scenarios are checked. Low-level layout/rendering adapters remain incomplete; export-name coverage does not establish complete Motion API parity.

higherOptimization.reason: The full entry passes behavior checks, but merged initialization retains too much code in narrow consumer bundles.
